invariants.rationale: The method 'commit' is called with 'result' and immediately calls methods on it, so it must not be null at entry.
The method invokes 'result.getWriteStatuses()', so the returned list must be non-null.
An empty list means size is 0; combining this with the stream usage in method body.
To map WriteStatus::getStat safely, all elements in the list should be non-null.
The code safely collects WriteStatus stats, implying the mapped result is non-null.
